title: Decision: v1 keeps read position and mute per device
description: Raised by crate-jmap-50 on JM-4 (.12.22): with Chat/set updates forbidden and no ReadPosition on the provider, a user's devices can't share read position, mute or pinned settings. Options: per-device state in each agent, or per-user Chat/set updates plus ReadPosition/get,set on the provider. Chosen (Mark, 2026-10-18): v1 keeps this state local to each agent; documented as a Limitation. No provider surface, and the provider learns less metadata. Revisit with the mobile epic (.40).
notes: Amended 2026-10-18 (Mark, audit item 4): pins removed from this decision. Base draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L518 lists pinnedMessageIds among shared group settings and L548 makes it admin-only in group chats, so per-device pins would diverge between members. v1: pins unsupported (Chat/set pinnedMessageIds refused, recorded on .12.22); if added later they belong in MLS group state.
